part.text:
Fixed in packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownLinks.ts:111. Three changes to the Markdown-link regex in `replaceMarkdownLinks`:

1. **Extension boundary** (the core bug): the `.md`/`.mdx` extension must be followed by a terminator (whitespace, `)`, `>`, `?`, `#`, quotes, or end of line) via `(?![^\s)#?'">])`. Previously `./file.md__static_image_assets__/image.png` matched a truncated `./file.md`, which linkify rewrote to the doc's permalink (`/docs/file...`), turning the relative image path into an absolute one and forcing the lookup in `/static` — exactly the reported failure.
2. **Stray spaces**: `\]\(` → `\]\(\s*` so `[URL]( ./file.md )` is linkified like the reference-style form already was.
3. **Bracketed URLs**: moved `<?` before the protocol exclusion and extended it to `<?https?://`, so `<https://example.com/file_(1).md>` is no longer misreported as a broken Markdown link.

Verified: the previously failing `markdownLinks.test.ts` cases (`does not replace non-Markdown links`, `handles stray spaces`) pass, all 14 tests there pass, and the consuming suites (`docusaurus-plugin-content-docs`, `content-blog`, `mdx-loader`, `docusaurus-utils`) show no new failures — the only remaining failures are pre-existing environment artifacts unrelated to the fix. Lint and typecheck pass.
